Metadata.title: 玩玩可物 • AI Media Studio
Metadata.description: Create images and videos with AI and turn ideas into media.

Landing.headline: Turn an idea into images and video
Landing.subheading: Create concept art, characters, and short-form motion with professional AI models.
Landing.seoTitle: Create AI images and videos from text in one studio
Landing.seoDescription: 玩玩可物 combines text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-image, and image-to-video tools for concept design, characters, visual pitches, social media assets, and short-form video.

textToImage.title: AI text-to-image generator
textToImage.body: Turn natural-language prompts into concept art, illustrations, characters, and stylized visuals.

textToVideo.title: AI text-to-video generator
textToVideo.body: Transform a scene description into a short video for storyboards, ideation, and content production.

imageToVideo.title: AI image-to-video generator
imageToVideo.body: Add motion and camera movement to a reference image and extend existing visual assets.

multiModel.title: Multi-model AI creative studio
multiModel.body: Choose models, aspect ratios, seeds, and reference images while preserving generation settings.

Landing.footer: © 2026 玩玩可物 • AI Media Studio
